spans.s:
m. (-कः)
Sorrow, grief.
E.
शुच to regret, aff. घञ्.

f. (-र्चा)
Indulgence in sorrow.
E.
शोक, and चर्चा search.

mfn. (-छिद्)
Consoling, allaying, removing sorrow.
E.
शोक, and छिद what cuts.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Afflicted, overcome with grief.
E.
शोक, and निहत struck.

m. (-ङ्गः)
Dissipating or removing sorrow.
E.
शाक, and भङ्ग breaking.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Involved in distress, swooning with grief.
E.
शोक, and मूर्च्छित fainted.

n. (-नं)
Site, circumstance, or occasion of sorrow.
E.
शोक, and स्थान place.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Overcome with sorrow.
E.
शोक, and आकुल bewildered.

m. (-ग्निः)
Deep distress, violent grief.
E.
शोक, and अग्नि fire; also similar compounds, as शोकानल, &c.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
Distressed.
E.
शोकाग्नि, and सन्तप्त inflamed.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
1 Alleviating, consoling.
2 Being consoled.
E.
शोक, and अपनुद what drives away.

m. (-दः)
A teacher of holy wisdom, a philosopher.
E.
शोक worldly care, अप away, नुद to send, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ)
Allaying or dissipating grief.
E.
शोक, and अपहर्त्तृ what drives away.

m. (-रिः)
The Kadamba tree, (Nauclea Kadamba.)
E.
शोक sorrow, अरि hostile.

mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं)
Pained, afflicted by sorrow.
E.
शोक, and आर्त्त pained.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Born or produced from or caused by grief.
E.
शोक, and उद्भब produced.
